findings.description: AWS access key and secret key are hard-coded in plaintext as Lambda environment variables, exposing long-lived IAM credentials to anyone with read access to the Terraform state, source control, or the Lambda console/API.

The Lambda function does not configure a customer-managed KMS key (kms_key_arn) for environment variable encryption, relying on default AWS-managed encryption and leaving sensitive values like the embedded credentials less protected and without key-level access control.
The function uses nodejs12.x, which is an end-of-life Node.js runtime no longer receiving security patches, increasing exposure to unpatched vulnerabilities.
